option_relations.rationale: The option describes infection-related glomerulonephritis, which is equivalent to post-infectious glomerulonephritis.
Focal segmental necrotizing immune-complex glomerulonephritis triggered by chronic infection is a specific type of post-infectious glomerulonephritis.
Membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (infection-related) is a specific type of post-infectious glomerulonephritis.

Infective endocarditis can lead to immune complex glomerulonephritis, making the latter a complication of the former. The option describes the primary disease as endocarditis, with glomerulonephritis as a secondary event.
